      "source": [
        "# Notebook: Redes Neuronales Convolucionales (CNN) para Imágenes Médicas\n",
        "\n",
        "Este notebook es una guía práctica para trabajar **CNN (Convolutional Neural Networks)** aplicadas a **imágenes médicas**.\n",
        "\n",
        "Trabajaremos con un conjunto de datos del paquete `medmnist`: **DermaMNIST**, un dataset de imágenes dermatoscópicas en formato 2D.\n",
        "\n",
        "Para que el tamaño del trabajo sea cercano a lo solicitado, se utilizará una muestra estratificada de **6000 imágenes** del dataset.\n",
        "\n",
        "Al final tendrás:\n",
        "- Un modelo CNN entrenado desde cero.\n",
        "- Un ejemplo de **transfer learning** usando un modelo preentrenado.\n",
        "- Evaluación con métricas útiles.\n",
        "- Un vistazo a interpretabilidad con **Grad-CAM**.\n",
        "- Desarrollo de los **5 ejercicios sugeridos**.\n",
        "\n",
        "⚠️ Nota importante: este material es educativo. Un modelo entrenado aquí **no** debe usarse para diagnóstico clínico.\n"
      ],
      "id": "_unGiyx0-bo8"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "G82bYXf6-bo-"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 1. ¿Qué es una CNN y por qué se usa en imágenes?\n",
        "\n",
        "Una **CNN** es un tipo de red neuronal diseñada para trabajar con datos que tienen estructura espacial, como imágenes.\n",
        "\n",
        "En una imagen, los píxeles cercanos suelen estar relacionados. Las CNN aprovechan esto mediante **convoluciones**, que son filtros aprendibles que detectan patrones.\n",
        "\n",
        "### 1.1. Componentes clave\n",
        "\n",
        "**(a) Convolución (Conv2D)**\n",
        "- Aplica filtros para obtener mapas de características.\n",
        "- Aprende bordes, texturas y formas.\n",
        "\n",
        "**(b) Activación (ReLU)**\n",
        "- Introduce no linealidad.\n",
        "- ReLU(x) = max(0, x).\n",
        "\n",
        "**(c) Pooling (MaxPool)**\n",
        "- Reduce la resolución espacial.\n",
        "- Ayuda a disminuir el costo computacional.\n",
        "\n",
        "**(d) Capas fully-connected**\n",
        "- Integran la información para la clasificación.\n",
        "\n",
        "### 1.2. ¿Por qué CNN para imágenes médicas?\n",
        "- Detectan patrones y texturas.\n",
        "- Pueden aprender características sin diseñarlas manualmente.\n",
        "- Con **transfer learning**, se puede aprovechar conocimiento de modelos ya entrenados.\n"
      ],
      "id": "G82bYXf6-bo-"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "KObhb0am-bo-"
      },
      "source": [

        "import random\n",
        "import copy\n",
        "import numpy as np\n",
        "import torch\n",
        "from torch.utils.data import DataLoader, Subset\n",
        "import torchvision.transforms as T\n",
        "import matplotlib.pyplot as plt\n",
        "from tqdm import tqdm\n",
        "\n",
        "import medmnist\n",
        "from medmnist import INFO\n",
        "from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split\n",
        "\n",
        "SEED = 42\n",
        "random.seed(SEED)\n",
        "np.random.seed(SEED)\n",
        "torch.manual_seed(SEED)\n",
        "\n",
        "if torch.cuda.is_available():\n",
        "    torch.cuda.manual_seed_all(SEED)\n",
        "\n",
        "data_flag = \"dermamnist\"\n",
        "info = INFO[data_flag]\n",
        "\n",
        "DataClass = getattr(medmnist, info[\"python_class\"])\n",
        "\n",
        "info\n"
      ],

      "cell_type": "code",

              "(4200, 600, 1200)"

      "source": [
        "transform_basic = T.Compose([\n",
        "    T.ToTensor()\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "train_full = DataClass(split=\"train\", transform=transform_basic, download=True)\n",
        "val_full = DataClass(split=\"val\", transform=transform_basic, download=True)\n",
        "test_full = DataClass(split=\"test\", transform=transform_basic, download=True)\n",
        "\n",
        "def stratified_indices(dataset, n, seed=42):\n",
        "    labels = np.asarray(dataset.labels).reshape(-1)\n",
        "    idx = np.arange(len(dataset))\n",
        "\n",
        "    selected, _ = train_test_split(\n",
        "        idx,\n",
        "        train_size=n,\n",
        "        stratify=labels,\n",
        "        random_state=seed\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    return selected.tolist()\n",
        "\n",
        "train_idx = stratified_indices(train_full, 4200, SEED)\n",
        "val_idx = stratified_indices(val_full, 600, SEED)\n",
        "test_idx = stratified_indices(test_full, 1200, SEED)\n",
        "\n",
        "train_dataset = Subset(train_full, train_idx)\n",
        "val_dataset = Subset(val_full, val_idx)\n",
        "test_dataset = Subset(test_full, test_idx)\n",
        "\n",
        "len(train_dataset), len(val_dataset), len(test_dataset)\n"
      ],
      "id": "A5mP3zQF-bpA"
    },

        "## 4. Preparar DataLoaders y device\n",
        "\n",

    {

      "source": [
        "device = torch.device(\"cuda\" if torch.cuda.is_available() else \"cpu\")\n",
        "device\n"

      "id": "O_IpX5cB-bpC"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "9XvmAwVy-bpD",
        "outputId": "87e64dc9-9fc1-4f74-b6ba-81ca18bef49c"
      },
      "execution_count": 6,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "execute_result",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "(torch.Size([128, 3, 28, 28]), torch.Size([128, 1]))"
            ]
          },

      ],
      "source": [
        "batch_size = 128\n",
        "\n",
        "# DataLoaders normales para validación y test\n",
        "val_loader = DataLoader(\n",
        "    val_dataset,\n",
        "    batch_size=batch_size,\n",
        "    shuffle=False,\n",
        "    num_workers=0\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "test_loader = DataLoader(\n",
        "    test_dataset,\n",
        "    batch_size=batch_size,\n",
        "    shuffle=False,\n",
        "    num_workers=0\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Para entrenamiento uso un muestreo moderadamente balanceado.\n",
        "# La idea es que la clase mayoritaria no domine todos los lotes.\n",
        "train_labels_subset = np.asarray(train_full.labels).reshape(-1)[train_idx]\n",
        "\n",
        "class_count = np.bincount(\n",
        "    train_labels_subset,\n",
        "    minlength=num_classes if \"num_classes\" in globals() else len(info[\"label\"])\n",
        ").astype(np.float32)\n",
        "\n",
        "# Peso suave: raíz inversa en vez de inversa completa\n",
        "class_sampling_weight = np.sqrt(class_count.max() / class_count)\n",
        "class_sampling_weight = np.clip(class_sampling_weight, 1.0, 2.5)\n",
        "\n",
        "sample_weights = class_sampling_weight[train_labels_subset]\n",
        "\n",
        "sampler = torch.utils.data.WeightedRandomSampler(\n",
        "    weights=torch.tensor(sample_weights, dtype=torch.double),\n",
        "    num_samples=len(train_dataset),\n",
        "    replacement=True\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "train_loader = DataLoader(\n",
        "    train_dataset,\n",
        "    batch_size=batch_size,\n",
        "    sampler=sampler,\n",
        "    num_workers=0\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "next(iter(train_loader))[0].shape, next(iter(train_loader))[1].shape\n"
      ],
      "id": "9XvmAwVy-bpD"

      "source": [
        "## 5. Modelo 1: CNN entrenada desde cero\n",
        "\n",
        "Construiremos una CNN básica y parecida a la del notebook original:\n",
        "- Bloques conv + ReLU + pooling.\n",
        "- BatchNorm para estabilizar el entrenamiento.\n",
        "- Dropout suave para evitar que el modelo memorice demasiado el conjunto de entrenamiento.\n",
        "- Al final, un clasificador.\n",
        "\n",
        "Como DermaMNIST tiene 3 canales, la primera convolución recibe 3 canales.\n",
        "\n",
        "**Cambio importante:** en una primera prueba el Training Accuracy quedaba muy por encima del Validation Accuracy. Para reducir esa diferencia se agregó regularización con Dropout y un muestreo moderadamente balanceado en entrenamiento.\n"
      ],
      "id": "ps1sRV67-bpD"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "3YanH5oj-bpD",
        "outputId": "b0a503f1-88fd-4453-b5b4-99dceceeac2b"
      },
      "execution_count": 7,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "execute_result",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "SimpleCNN(\n",
              "  (features): Sequential(\n",
              "    (0): Conv2d(3, 24, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1))\n",
              "    (1): BatchNorm2d(24, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)\n",
              "    (2): ReLU()\n",
              "    (3): MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2, padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False)\n",
              "    (4): Dropout2d(p=0.1, inplace=False)\n",
              "    (5): Conv2d(24, 48, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1))\n",
              "    (6): BatchNorm2d(48, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)\n",
              "    (7): ReLU()\n",
              "    (8): MaxPool2d(kernel_size=2, stride=2, padding=0, dilation=1, ceil_mode=False)\n",
              "    (9): Dropout2d(p=0.15, inplace=False)\n",
              "    (10): Conv2d(48, 96, kernel_size=(3, 3), stride=(1, 1), padding=(1, 1))\n",
              "    (11): BatchNorm2d(96, eps=1e-05, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True)\n",
              "    (12): ReLU()\n",
              "    (13): AdaptiveAvgPool2d(output_size=(1, 1))\n",
              "  )\n",
              "  (classifier): Sequential(\n",
              "    (0): Flatten(start_dim=1, end_dim=-1)\n",
              "    (1): Dropout(p=0.45, inplace=False)\n",
              "    (2): Linear(in_features=96, out_features=7, bias=True)\n",
              "  )\n",
              ")"
            ]
          },
          "metadata": {},
          "execution_count": 7
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "import torch.nn as nn\n",
        "import torch.nn.functional as F\n",
        "\n",
        "num_classes = len(info[\"label\"])\n",
        "\n",
        "class SimpleCNN(nn.Module):\n",
        "    def __init__(self, num_classes):\n",
        "        super().__init__()\n",
        "\n",
        "        self.features = nn.Sequential(\n",
        "            nn.Conv2d(3, 24, kernel_size=3, padding=1),\n",
        "            nn.BatchNorm2d(24),\n",
        "            nn.ReLU(),\n",
        "            nn.MaxPool2d(2),\n",
        "            nn.Dropout2d(0.10),\n",
        "\n",
        "            nn.Conv2d(24, 48, kernel_size=3, padding=1),\n",
        "            nn.BatchNorm2d(48),\n",
        "            nn.ReLU(),\n",
        "            nn.MaxPool2d(2),\n",
        "            nn.Dropout2d(0.15),\n",
        "\n",
        "            nn.Conv2d(48, 96, kernel_size=3, padding=1),\n",
        "            nn.BatchNorm2d(96),\n",
        "            nn.ReLU(),\n",
        "            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(\n",
        "            nn.Flatten(),\n",
        "            nn.Dropout(0.45),\n",
        "            nn.Linear(96, num_classes)\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "    def forward(self, x):\n",
        "        x = self.features(x)\n",
        "        x = self.classifier(x)\n",
        "        return x\n",
        "\n",
        "model_scratch = SimpleCNN(num_classes=num_classes).to(device)\n",
        "model_scratch\n"
      ],
      "id": "3YanH5oj-bpD"
    },
    {

      "source": [
        "### 5.1. Funciones de entrenamiento y evaluación\n",
        "\n",
        "En clasificación es útil mirar:\n",
        "- **Accuracy**\n",
        "- **ROC-AUC**\n",
        "- **Matriz de confusión**\n",
        "- **Precision/Recall/F1**\n",
        "\n",
        "También guardaremos:\n",
        "- pérdida de entrenamiento,\n",
        "- pérdida de validación,\n",
        "- accuracy de entrenamiento,\n",
        "- accuracy de validación.\n",
        "\n",
        "Esto permite comparar entrenamiento y validación con la misma métrica.\n"
      ],
      "id": "_DRVwMaS-bpD"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "kn4PdkfZ-bpD"
      },
      "execution_count": 8,
      "outputs": [],
      "source": [
        "from sklearn.metrics import (\n",
        "    accuracy_score,\n",
        "    roc_auc_score,\n",
        "    classification_report,\n",
        "    confusion_matrix\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "@torch.no_grad()\n",
        "def evaluate(model, loader):\n",
        "    model.eval()\n",
        "\n",
        "    all_labels = []\n",
        "    all_probs = []\n",
        "    all_preds = []\n",
        "\n",
        "    for x, y in loader:\n",
        "        x = x.to(device)\n",
        "        y = y.to(device).long().squeeze(1)\n",
        "\n",
        "        logits = model(x)\n",
        "        probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)\n",
        "        preds = torch.argmax(probs, dim=1)\n",
        "\n",
        "        all_labels.append(y.cpu().numpy())\n",
        "        all_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())\n",
        "        all_preds.append(preds.cpu().numpy())\n",
        "\n",
        "    y_true = np.concatenate(all_labels)\n",
        "    y_prob = np.concatenate(all_probs)\n",
        "    y_pred = np.concatenate(all_preds)\n",
        "\n",
        "    acc = accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred)\n",
        "\n",
        "    auc = roc_auc_score(\n",
        "        y_true,\n",
        "        y_prob,\n",
        "        multi_class=\"ovr\",\n",
        "        average=\"macro\"\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    return acc, auc, y_true, y_pred, y_prob\n",
        "\n",
        "@torch.no_grad()\n",
        "def evaluate_with_loss(model, loader, criterion):\n",
        "    model.eval()\n",
        "\n",
        "    losses = []\n",
        "    all_labels = []\n",
        "    all_probs = []\n",
        "    all_preds = []\n",
        "\n",
        "    for x, y in loader:\n",
        "        x = x.to(device)\n",
        "        y = y.to(device).long().squeeze(1)\n",
        "\n",
        "        logits = model(x)\n",
        "        loss = criterion(logits, y)\n",
        "\n",
        "        probs = torch.softmax(logits, dim=1)\n",
        "        preds = torch.argmax(probs, dim=1)\n",
        "\n",
        "        losses.append(loss.item())\n",
        "        all_labels.append(y.cpu().numpy())\n",
        "        all_probs.append(probs.cpu().numpy())\n",
        "        all_preds.append(preds.cpu().numpy())\n",
        "\n",
        "    y_true = np.concatenate(all_labels)\n",
        "    y_prob = np.concatenate(all_probs)\n",
        "    y_pred = np.concatenate(all_preds)\n",
        "\n",
        "    val_loss = float(np.mean(losses))\n",
        "    val_acc = accuracy_score(y_true, y_pred)\n",
        "\n",
        "    val_auc = roc_auc_score(\n",
        "        y_true,\n",
        "        y_prob,\n",
        "        multi_class=\"ovr\",\n",
        "        average=\"macro\"\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    return val_loss, val_acc, val_auc\n",
        "\n",
        "def train_one_epoch(model, loader, optimizer, criterion):\n",
        "    model.train()\n",
        "\n",
        "    losses = []\n",
        "    correct = 0\n",
        "    total = 0\n",
        "\n",
        "    for x, y in loader:\n",
        "        x = x.to(device)\n",
        "        y = y.to(device).long().squeeze(1)\n",
        "\n",
        "        optimizer.zero_grad()\n",
        "\n",
        "        logits = model(x)\n",
        "        loss = criterion(logits, y)\n",
        "\n",
        "        loss.backward()\n",
        "        optimizer.step()\n",
        "\n",
        "        preds = torch.argmax(logits, dim=1)\n",
        "\n",
        "        correct += (preds == y).sum().item()\n",
        "        total += y.size(0)\n",
        "\n",
        "        losses.append(loss.item())\n",
        "\n",
        "    train_loss = float(np.mean(losses))\n",
        "    train_acc = correct / total\n",
        "\n",
        "    return train_loss, train_acc\n"
      ],
      "id": "kn4PdkfZ-bpD"
    },

      "source": [
        "### 5.2. Entrenar el modelo desde cero\n",
        "\n",
        "Se entrenan hasta **40 épocas** para observar mejor la tendencia del modelo.\n",
        "\n",
        "Se mantiene `Early Stopping`, por lo que si la validación deja de mejorar durante varias épocas el entrenamiento puede detenerse antes.\n",
        "\n",
        "Además:\n",
        "- `label_smoothing` evita que el modelo se vuelva demasiado seguro;\n",
        "- `weight_decay` ayuda a reducir sobreajuste;\n",
        "- el scheduler disminuye el learning rate si la validación deja de mejorar.\n",
        "\n",
        "El objetivo es obtener una evolución más estable y que las curvas de entrenamiento y validación no presenten cambios tan bruscos.\n"

      "source": [
        "# Label smoothing evita que el modelo se vuelva demasiado seguro.\n",
        "criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(\n",
        "    label_smoothing=0.08\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# AdamW agrega regularización mediante weight decay.\n",
        "optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(\n",
        "    model_scratch.parameters(),\n",
        "    lr=5e-4,\n",
        "    weight_decay=5e-4\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Si la validación deja de mejorar, se reduce el learning rate.\n",
        "scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.ReduceLROnPlateau(\n",
        "    optimizer,\n",
        "    mode=\"min\",\n",
        "    factor=0.5,\n",
        "    patience=3\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "epochs = 40\n",
        "\n",
        "history_scratch = {\n",
        "    \"train_loss\": [],\n",
        "    \"val_loss\": [],\n",
        "    \"train_acc\": [],\n",
        "    \"val_acc\": [],\n",
        "    \"val_auc\": []\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "best_val_loss = float(\"inf\")\n",
        "best_state = copy.deepcopy(\n",
        "    model_scratch.state_dict()\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "patience = 10\n",
        "wait = 0\n",
        "\n",
        "for epoch in range(1, epochs + 1):\n",
        "    train_loss, train_acc = train_one_epoch(\n",
        "        model_scratch,\n",
        "        train_loader,\n",
        "        optimizer,\n",
        "        criterion\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    val_loss, val_acc, val_auc = evaluate_with_loss(\n",
        "        model_scratch,\n",
        "        val_loader,\n",
        "        criterion\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    history_scratch[\"train_loss\"].append(train_loss)\n",
        "    history_scratch[\"val_loss\"].append(val_loss)\n",
        "    history_scratch[\"train_acc\"].append(train_acc)\n",
        "    history_scratch[\"val_acc\"].append(val_acc)\n",
        "    history_scratch[\"val_auc\"].append(val_auc)\n",
        "\n",
        "    scheduler.step(val_loss)\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Guardamos la mejor versión según la pérdida de validación.\n",
        "    if val_loss < best_val_loss:\n",
        "        best_val_loss = val_loss\n",
        "        best_state = copy.deepcopy(\n",
        "            model_scratch.state_dict()\n",
        "        )\n",
        "        wait = 0\n",
        "    else:\n",
        "        wait += 1\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\n",
        "        f\"Epoch {epoch:02d} | \"\n",
        "        f\"train_loss={train_loss:.4f} | \"\n",
        "        f\"val_loss={val_loss:.4f} | \"\n",
        "        f\"train_acc={train_acc:.4f} | \"\n",
        "        f\"val_acc={val_acc:.4f} | \"\n",
        "        f\"val_auc={val_auc:.4f}\"\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    if wait >= patience:\n",
        "        print(\n",
        "            f\"Early stopping en la época {epoch}\"\n",
        "        )\n",
        "        break\n",
        "\n",
        "# Recuperamos el modelo con mejor validación.\n",
        "model_scratch.load_state_dict(\n",
        "    best_state\n",
        ")\n"
      ],
      "id": "KkBw39PZ-bpE"

        "epochs_axis = np.arange(\n",
        "    1,\n",
        "    len(history_scratch[\"train_loss\"]) + 1\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Promedio móvil solo para visualizar mejor la tendencia.\n",
        "# Los valores originales no se modifican.\n",
        "def moving_average(values, window=5):\n",
        "    values = np.asarray(values, dtype=float)\n",
        "\n",
        "    if len(values) < window:\n",
        "        return values\n",
        "\n",
        "    kernel = np.ones(window) / window\n",
        "    smooth = np.convolve(\n",
        "        values,\n",
        "        kernel,\n",
        "        mode=\"valid\"\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    # Se rellenan los primeros puntos para mantener el mismo largo.\n",
        "    prefix = [\n",
        "        np.mean(values[:i])\n",
        "        for i in range(1, window)\n",
        "    ]\n",
        "\n",
        "    return np.concatenate([\n",
        "        np.asarray(prefix),\n",
        "        smooth\n",
        "    ])\n",
        "\n",
        "train_loss_smooth = moving_average(\n",
        "    history_scratch[\"train_loss\"],\n",
        "    window=5\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "val_loss_smooth = moving_average(\n",
        "    history_scratch[\"val_loss\"],\n",
        "    window=5\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "train_acc_smooth = moving_average(\n",
        "    history_scratch[\"train_acc\"],\n",
        "    window=5\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "val_acc_smooth = moving_average(\n",
        "    history_scratch[\"val_acc\"],\n",
        "    window=5\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# -----------------------------\n",
        "# Gráfica 1: Loss\n",
        "# -----------------------------\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(11, 4.5))\n",
        "\n",
        "# Valores reales con menor intensidad\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    epochs_axis,\n",
        "    history_scratch[\"train_loss\"],\n",
        "    alpha=0.20,\n",
        "    linewidth=1\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    epochs_axis,\n",
        "    history_scratch[\"val_loss\"],\n",
        "    alpha=0.20,\n",
        "    linewidth=1\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Tendencia suavizada\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",

        "    label=\"Training loss\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",

        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"Pérdida de entrenamiento y validación\")\n",

        "plt.ylabel(\"Loss\")\n",
        "plt.xlim(1, len(epochs_axis))\n",

        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    epochs_axis,\n",
        "    history_scratch[\"train_acc\"],\n",
        "    alpha=0.20,\n",
        "    linewidth=1\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    epochs_axis,\n",
        "    history_scratch[\"val_acc\"],\n",
        "    alpha=0.20,\n",

        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "# Tendencia suavizada\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",

        "    label=\"Training accuracy\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    epochs_axis,\n",
        "    val_acc_smooth,\n",
        "    linewidth=2.5,\n",
        "    label=\"Validation accuracy\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"Accuracy de entrenamiento y validación\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"Época\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"Accuracy\")\n",
        "plt.xlim(1, len(epochs_axis))\n",
        "plt.legend()\n",

      "source": [
        "**Comentario:** para que la tendencia se vea más clara, las gráficas muestran dos cosas:\n",
        "\n",
        "- una línea tenue con los valores reales de cada época;\n",
        "- una línea más gruesa con un **promedio móvil de 5 épocas**.\n",
        "\n",
        "El promedio móvil no cambia los resultados del modelo. Solo reduce visualmente los picos para que sea más fácil observar la tendencia general.\n",

        "### 5.5. EJERCICIO 1 — Cambiar la arquitectura de la CNN\n",
        "\n",
        "Para este ejercicio se modifica la arquitectura agregando:\n",
        "\n",
        "- una capa convolucional adicional;\n",
        "- más filtros;\n",
        "- `BatchNorm`;\n",
        "- `Dropout`.\n",
        "\n",
        "La CNN modificada se compara con la CNN base usando **Validation Accuracy**.\n",
        "\n",
        "La CNN base ya incluye regularización para controlar el sobreajuste. En este ejercicio el cambio principal sigue siendo la arquitectura.\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "Para que la comparación sea más clara, los experimentos se extienden hasta **40 épocas**.\n"
      ],
      "id": "vzcy1JV8-bpF"

      "source": [
        "class ImprovedCNN(nn.Module):\n",
        "    def __init__(self, num_classes):\n",
        "        super().__init__()\n",
        "\n",
        "        self.features = nn.Sequential(\n",
        "            nn.Conv2d(3, 32, kernel_size=3, padding=1),\n",
        "            nn.BatchNorm2d(32),\n",
        "            nn.ReLU(),\n",
        "            nn.MaxPool2d(2),\n",
        "\n",
        "            nn.Conv2d(32, 64, kernel_size=3, padding=1),\n",
        "            nn.BatchNorm2d(64),\n",
        "            nn.ReLU(),\n",
        "            nn.MaxPool2d(2),\n",
        "\n",
        "            nn.Conv2d(64, 128, kernel_size=3, padding=1),\n",
        "            nn.BatchNorm2d(128),\n",
        "            nn.ReLU(),\n",
        "\n",
        "            nn.Conv2d(128, 160, kernel_size=3, padding=1),\n",
        "            nn.BatchNorm2d(160),\n",
        "            nn.ReLU(),\n",
        "\n",
        "            nn.AdaptiveAvgPool2d((1, 1))\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "        self.classifier = nn.Sequential(\n",
        "            nn.Flatten(),\n",
        "            nn.Dropout(0.40),\n",
        "            nn.Linear(160, num_classes)\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "    def forward(self, x):\n",
        "        x = self.features(x)\n",
        "        x = self.classifier(x)\n",
        "        return x\n",
        "\n",
        "model_arch = ImprovedCNN(\n",
        "    num_classes=num_classes\n",
        ").to(device)\n",
        "\n",
        "criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss(\n",
        "    label_smoothing=0.08\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "optimizer = torch.optim.AdamW(\n",
        "    model_arch.parameters(),\n",
        "    lr=5e-4,\n",
        "    weight_decay=5e-4\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "history_arch = {\n",
        "    \"train_loss\": [],\n",
        "    \"val_loss\": [],\n",
        "    \"train_acc\": [],\n",
        "    \"val_acc\": [],\n",
        "    \"val_auc\": []\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "for epoch in range(1, 41):\n",
        "    train_loss, train_acc = train_one_epoch(\n",
        "        model_arch,\n",
        "        train_loader,\n",
        "        optimizer,\n",
        "        criterion\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    val_loss, val_acc, val_auc = evaluate_with_loss(\n",
        "        model_arch,\n",
        "        val_loader,\n",
        "        criterion\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    history_arch[\"train_loss\"].append(train_loss)\n",
        "    history_arch[\"val_loss\"].append(val_loss)\n",
        "    history_arch[\"train_acc\"].append(train_acc)\n",
        "    history_arch[\"val_acc\"].append(val_acc)\n",
        "    history_arch[\"val_auc\"].append(val_auc)\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\n",
        "        f\"Epoch {epoch:02d} | \"\n",
        "        f\"train_acc={train_acc:.4f} | \"\n",
        "        f\"val_acc={val_acc:.4f}\"\n",
        "    )\n"
      ],
      "id": "o8tgtSzt-bpF"

      "source": [
        "### 5.6. EJERCICIO 2 — Learning rate y scheduler\n",
        "\n",
        "Se prueban tres valores de learning rate:\n",
        "\n",
        "- `1e-2`\n",
        "- `1e-3`\n",
        "- `1e-4`\n",
        "\n",
        "Primero se comparan usando **Validation Accuracy**. Después se toma el mejor learning rate y se vuelve a entrenar usando un `StepLR`.\n",
        "\n",
        "**Qué quiero observar:** qué learning rate produce un aprendizaje más estable y si reducirlo progresivamente con el scheduler ayuda a mantener o mejorar el Accuracy.\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "Para que la comparación sea más clara, los experimentos se extienden hasta **40 épocas**.\n"
      ],
      "id": "H39RL0tV-bpF"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "egO4HNhk-bpG",
        "outputId": "4aff4422-4e16-448a-9f57-b49adc6117fb"
      },
      "execution_count": 15,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Mejor learning rate: 0.01\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "learning_rates = [1e-2, 1e-3, 1e-4]\n",
        "\n",
        "lr_results = {}\n",
        "\n",
        "for lr in learning_rates:\n",
        "    model_lr = SimpleCNN(num_classes=num_classes).to(device)\n",
        "    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()\n",
        "    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(model_lr.parameters(), lr=lr)\n",
        "\n",
        "    hist = {\n",
        "        \"val_acc\": [],\n",
        "        \"val_auc\": []\n",
        "    }\n",
        "\n",
        "    for epoch in range(1, 41):\n",
        "        train_one_epoch(\n",
        "            model_lr,\n",
        "            train_loader,\n",
        "            optimizer,\n",
        "            criterion\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "        _, val_acc, val_auc = evaluate_with_loss(\n",
        "            model_lr,\n",
        "            val_loader,\n",
        "            criterion\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "        hist[\"val_acc\"].append(val_acc)\n",
        "        hist[\"val_auc\"].append(val_auc)\n",
        "\n",
        "    lr_results[lr] = hist\n",
        "\n",
        "best_lr = max(\n",
        "    learning_rates,\n",
        "    key=lambda lr: max(lr_results[lr][\"val_acc\"])\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Mejor learning rate:\", best_lr)\n"
      ],
      "id": "egO4HNhk-bpG"
    },

      "source": [
        "model_scheduler = SimpleCNN(num_classes=num_classes).to(device)\n",
        "\n",
        "criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()\n",
        "optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(\n",
        "    model_scheduler.parameters(),\n",
        "    lr=best_lr\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "scheduler = torch.optim.lr_scheduler.StepLR(\n",
        "    optimizer,\n",
        "    step_size=7,\n",
        "    gamma=0.5\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "history_scheduler = {\n",
        "    \"val_acc\": []\n",
        "}\n",
        "\n",
        "for epoch in range(1, 41):\n",
        "    train_one_epoch(\n",
        "        model_scheduler,\n",
        "        train_loader,\n",
        "        optimizer,\n",
        "        criterion\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    _, val_acc, _ = evaluate_with_loss(\n",
        "        model_scheduler,\n",
        "        val_loader,\n",
        "        criterion\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    history_scheduler[\"val_acc\"].append(val_acc)\n",
        "\n",
        "    scheduler.step()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4))\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    lr_results[best_lr][\"val_acc\"],\n",
        "    label=\"Sin scheduler\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    history_scheduler[\"val_acc\"],\n",
        "    label=\"Con StepLR\"\n",
        ")\n",

      "source": [
        "## 6. Data Augmentation (aumento de datos) — EJERCICIO 3\n",
        "\n",
        "En imágenes médicas, el aumento de datos puede ayudar a generalizar, pero debe aplicarse con cuidado.\n",
        "\n",
        "Se comparan tres opciones:\n",
        "\n",
        "1. **Sin augmentation**\n",
        "2. **Augmentation suave**\n",
        "3. **Augmentation fuerte**\n",
        "\n",
        "En las tres opciones se mantiene la misma arquitectura y se compara el **Validation Accuracy**.\n",
        "\n",
        "**Qué quiero observar:** si pequeñas variaciones de las imágenes ayudan al modelo a generalizar mejor sin deformar demasiado la información original.\n",
        "\n",
        "\n",
        "Para que la comparación sea más clara, los experimentos se extienden hasta **40 épocas**.\n"
      ],
      "id": "yyiz6DkB-bpG"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "ZPO5rpOh-bpG"
      },
      "execution_count": 18,
      "outputs": [],
      "source": [
        "transform_none = T.Compose([\n",
        "    T.ToTensor()\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "transform_mild = T.Compose([\n",
        "    T.RandomRotation(degrees=8),\n",
        "    T.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.30),\n",
        "    T.ToTensor()\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "transform_strong = T.Compose([\n",
        "    T.RandomRotation(degrees=15),\n",
        "    T.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.50),\n",
        "    T.ColorJitter(brightness=0.10, contrast=0.10),\n",
        "    T.ToTensor()\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "aug_transforms = {\n",
        "    \"Sin augmentation\": transform_none,\n",
        "    \"Suave\": transform_mild,\n",
        "    \"Fuerte\": transform_strong\n",
        "}\n"
      ],
      "id": "ZPO5rpOh-bpG"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "3Eyyovh9-bpG",
        "outputId": "4f1fa043-29e8-4c76-8d20-4c3920989793"
      },
      "execution_count": 19,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Mejor augmentation: Sin augmentation\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "aug_histories = {}\n",
        "aug_models = {}\n",
        "\n",
        "for name, transform in aug_transforms.items():\n",
        "    train_full_aug = DataClass(\n",
        "        split=\"train\",\n",
        "        transform=transform,\n",
        "        download=True\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    train_dataset_aug = Subset(\n",
        "        train_full_aug,\n",
        "        train_idx\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    train_loader_aug = DataLoader(\n",
        "        train_dataset_aug,\n",
        "        batch_size=batch_size,\n",
        "        shuffle=True,\n",
        "        num_workers=0\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    model_aug = SimpleCNN(\n",
        "        num_classes=num_classes\n",
        "    ).to(device)\n",
        "\n",
        "    criterion = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()\n",
        "    optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(\n",
        "        model_aug.parameters(),\n",
        "        lr=best_lr\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    hist = {\n",
        "        \"val_acc\": []\n",
        "    }\n",
        "\n",
        "    for epoch in range(1, 41):\n",
        "        train_one_epoch(\n",
        "            model_aug,\n",
        "            train_loader_aug,\n",
        "            optimizer,\n",
        "            criterion\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "        _, val_acc, _ = evaluate_with_loss(\n",
        "            model_aug,\n",
        "            val_loader,\n",
        "            criterion\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "        hist[\"val_acc\"].append(val_acc)\n",
        "\n",
        "    aug_histories[name] = hist\n",
        "    aug_models[name] = model_aug\n",
        "\n",
        "best_aug_name = max(\n",
        "    aug_histories,\n",
        "    key=lambda name: max(\n",
        "        aug_histories[name][\"val_acc\"]\n",
        "    )\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Mejor augmentation:\", best_aug_name)\n"
      ],
      "id": "3Eyyovh9-bpG"
    },

      "cell_type": "markdown",

      },
      "source": [
        "## 7. Transfer Learning en imágenes médicas\n",
        "\n",
        "El **transfer learning** consiste en reutilizar un modelo entrenado en un dataset grande y adaptarlo a la nueva tarea.\n",
        "\n",
        "Aquí usamos **ResNet18**:\n",
        "1) Redimensionamos la imagen.\n",
        "2) Normalizamos.\n",
        "3) Entrenamos un clasificador encima.\n"
      ],
      "id": "wCAJyHVo-bpG"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "0dm3KNBZ-bpG",
        "outputId": "1112a4e7-7681-4ffb-9039-f382b2c2a69b"
      },
      "execution_count": 21,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "execute_result",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "torch.Size([64, 3, 224, 224])"
            ]
          },
          "metadata": {},
          "execution_count": 21
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "import torchvision.models as models\n",
        "\n",
        "imagenet_mean = [0.485, 0.456, 0.406]\n",
        "imagenet_std = [0.229, 0.224, 0.225]\n",
        "\n",
        "transform_tl_train = T.Compose([\n",
        "    T.Resize((224, 224)),\n",
        "    T.RandomRotation(degrees=8),\n",
        "    T.RandomHorizontalFlip(p=0.30),\n",
        "    T.ToTensor(),\n",
        "    T.Normalize(imagenet_mean, imagenet_std)\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "transform_tl_eval = T.Compose([\n",
        "    T.Resize((224, 224)),\n",
        "    T.ToTensor(),\n",
        "    T.Normalize(imagenet_mean, imagenet_std)\n",
        "])\n",
        "\n",
        "train_full_tl = DataClass(\n",
        "    split=\"train\",\n",
        "    transform=transform_tl_train,\n",
        "    download=True\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "val_full_tl = DataClass(\n",
        "    split=\"val\",\n",
        "    transform=transform_tl_eval,\n",
        "    download=True\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "test_full_tl = DataClass(\n",
        "    split=\"test\",\n",
        "    transform=transform_tl_eval,\n",
        "    download=True\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "train_dataset_tl = Subset(train_full_tl, train_idx)\n",
        "val_dataset_tl = Subset(val_full_tl, val_idx)\n",
        "test_dataset_tl = Subset(test_full_tl, test_idx)\n",
        "\n",
        "train_loader_tl = DataLoader(\n",
        "    train_dataset_tl,\n",
        "    batch_size=64,\n",
        "    shuffle=True,\n",
        "    num_workers=0\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "val_loader_tl = DataLoader(\n",
        "    val_dataset_tl,\n",
        "    batch_size=64,\n",
        "    shuffle=False,\n",
        "    num_workers=0\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "test_loader_tl = DataLoader(\n",
        "    test_dataset_tl,\n",
        "    batch_size=64,\n",
        "    shuffle=False,\n",
        "    num_workers=0\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "next(iter(train_loader_tl))[0].shape\n"
      ],
      "id": "0dm3KNBZ-bpG"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "BQ5fmGXK-bpI"
      },
      "source": [
        "### 7.1. Construir el modelo preentrenado\n",
        "\n",
        "Usaremos **ResNet18** preentrenada en ImageNet.\n",
        "\n",
        "Estrategia:\n",
        "- Congelar el backbone al inicio.\n",
        "- Entrenar solo la última capa.\n"
      ],
      "id": "BQ5fmGXK-bpI"
    },

      "source": [
        "resnet = models.resnet18(\n",
        "    weights=models.ResNet18_Weights.DEFAULT\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "in_features = resnet.fc.in_features\n",
        "resnet.fc = nn.Linear(\n",
        "    in_features,\n",
        "    num_classes\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "resnet = resnet.to(device)\n",
        "\n",
        "for param in resnet.parameters():\n",
        "    param.requires_grad = False\n",
        "\n",
        "for param in resnet.fc.parameters():\n",
        "    param.requires_grad = True\n",
        "\n",
        "resnet\n"

        "        f\"val_acc={val_acc:.4f} | \"\n",
        "        f\"val_auc={val_auc:.4f}\"\n",
        "    )\n"

      "source": [
        "### 7.2. Fine-tuning (descongelar capas)\n",
        "\n",
        "Ahora permitimos que el modelo ajuste parte del backbone.\n"
      ],
      "id": "zAszO4J8-bpI"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "tv-G1EUi-bpI",
        "outputId": "fa783623-33cb-4d6a-c968-0f9d77c0d47f"

          "text": [

            "Stage2 Epoch 02 | train_acc=0.7864 | val_acc=0.7483 | val_auc=0.9277\n",
            "Stage2 Epoch 03 | train_acc=0.8181 | val_acc=0.7567 | val_auc=0.9263\n",

          ]

      ],
      "source": [
        "for name, param in resnet.named_parameters():\n",
        "    if name.startswith(\"layer4\") or name.startswith(\"fc\"):\n",
        "        param.requires_grad = True\n",
        "\n",
        "trainable_params = [\n",
        "    p for p in resnet.parameters()\n",
        "    if p.requires_grad\n",
        "]\n",
        "\n",
        "optimizer = torch.optim.Adam(\n",
        "    trainable_params,\n",
        "    lr=1e-4\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "for epoch in range(1, 5):\n",
        "    train_loss, train_acc = train_one_epoch(\n",
        "        resnet,\n",
        "        train_loader_tl,\n",
        "        optimizer,\n",
        "        criterion\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    val_loss, val_acc, val_auc = evaluate_with_loss(\n",
        "        resnet,\n",
        "        val_loader_tl,\n",
        "        criterion\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    print(\n",
        "        f\"Stage2 Epoch {epoch:02d} | \"\n",

        "        f\"val_acc={val_acc:.4f} | \"\n",
        "        f\"val_auc={val_auc:.4f}\"\n",
        "    )\n"

      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "NvnAm50e-bpJ"
      },
      "source": [
        "### 7.5. EJERCICIO 5 — Calibración de probabilidades y curvas ROC\n",
        "\n",
        "Se aplica **Temperature Scaling** sobre el modelo con transfer learning.\n",
        "\n",
        "La temperatura se aprende usando el conjunto de validación. Luego se comparan las probabilidades del modelo antes y después de calibrar.\n",
        "\n",
        "Se analizarán:\n",
        "\n",
        "- NLL antes y después;\n",
        "- ROC-AUC macro antes y después;\n",
        "- curva ROC macro antes y después de calibrar.\n",
        "\n",
        "**Qué quiero observar:** la calibración busca mejorar la confianza de las probabilidades. Por eso el NLL puede mejorar aunque el ROC-AUC cambie muy poco.\n"
      ],
      "id": "NvnAm50e-bpJ"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "u0sfHuCo-bpJ"
      },
      "execution_count": 27,
      "outputs": [],
      "source": [
        "from sklearn.metrics import log_loss\n",
        "\n",
        "@torch.no_grad()\n",
        "def collect_logits_labels(model, loader):\n",
        "    model.eval()\n",
        "\n",
        "    logits_list = []\n",
        "    labels_list = []\n",
        "\n",
        "    for x, y in loader:\n",
        "        x = x.to(device)\n",
        "        y = y.to(device).long().squeeze(1)\n",
        "\n",
        "        logits = model(x)\n",
        "\n",
        "        logits_list.append(\n",
        "            logits.cpu()\n",
        "        )\n",
        "        labels_list.append(\n",
        "            y.cpu()\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "    return (\n",
        "        torch.cat(logits_list),\n",
        "        torch.cat(labels_list)\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "val_logits, val_targets = collect_logits_labels(\n",
        "    resnet,\n",
        "    val_loader_tl\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "test_logits, test_targets = collect_logits_labels(\n",
        "    resnet,\n",
        "    test_loader_tl\n",
        ")\n"
      ],
      "id": "u0sfHuCo-bpJ"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "CAhwsuAn-bpK",
        "outputId": "8b3e1998-84e3-4036-d21a-75145f0eac76"
      },
      "execution_count": 28,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "Temperatura: 1.4709\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "class TemperatureScaler(nn.Module):\n",
        "    def __init__(self):\n",
        "        super().__init__()\n",
        "        self.log_temperature = nn.Parameter(\n",
        "            torch.zeros(1)\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "    def forward(self, logits):\n",
        "        temperature = torch.exp(\n",
        "            self.log_temperature\n",
        "        )\n",
        "        return logits / temperature\n",
        "\n",
        "scaler = TemperatureScaler().to(device)\n",
        "\n",
        "criterion_cal = nn.CrossEntropyLoss()\n",
        "\n",
        "optimizer_cal = torch.optim.LBFGS(\n",
        "    [scaler.log_temperature],\n",
        "    lr=0.05,\n",
        "    max_iter=100\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "val_logits_device = val_logits.to(device)\n",
        "val_targets_device = val_targets.to(device)\n",
        "\n",
        "def closure():\n",
        "    optimizer_cal.zero_grad()\n",
        "\n",
        "    loss = criterion_cal(\n",
        "        scaler(val_logits_device),\n",
        "        val_targets_device\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    loss.backward()\n",
        "\n",
        "    return loss\n",
        "\n",
        "optimizer_cal.step(closure)\n",
        "\n",
        "temperature = torch.exp(\n",
        "    scaler.log_temperature\n",
        ").item()\n",
        "\n",
        "print(\"Temperatura:\", round(temperature, 4))\n"
      ],
      "id": "CAhwsuAn-bpK"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/"
        },
        "id": "1XbZFhoP-bpK",
        "outputId": "83517e04-3eef-4299-8f7a-e35804159cb5"
      },
      "execution_count": 29,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stdout",
          "text": [
            "NLL antes:   0.7136\n",
            "NLL después: 0.6595\n",
            "AUC antes:   0.9287\n",
            "AUC después: 0.9294\n"
          ]
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "with torch.no_grad():\n",
        "    probs_before = torch.softmax(\n",
        "        test_logits,\n",
        "        dim=1\n",
        "    ).numpy()\n",
        "\n",
        "    calibrated_logits = scaler(\n",
        "        test_logits.to(device)\n",
        "    ).cpu()\n",
        "\n",
        "    probs_after = torch.softmax(\n",
        "        calibrated_logits,\n",
        "        dim=1\n",
        "    ).numpy()\n",
        "\n",
        "y_test = test_targets.numpy()\n",
        "\n",
        "auc_before = roc_auc_score(\n",
        "    y_test,\n",
        "    probs_before,\n",
        "    multi_class=\"ovr\",\n",
        "    average=\"macro\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "auc_after = roc_auc_score(\n",
        "    y_test,\n",
        "    probs_after,\n",
        "    multi_class=\"ovr\",\n",
        "    average=\"macro\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "nll_before = log_loss(\n",
        "    y_test,\n",
        "    probs_before,\n",
        "    labels=np.arange(num_classes)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "nll_after = log_loss(\n",
        "    y_test,\n",
        "    probs_after,\n",
        "    labels=np.arange(num_classes)\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "print(f\"NLL antes:   {nll_before:.4f}\")\n",
        "print(f\"NLL después: {nll_after:.4f}\")\n",
        "print(f\"AUC antes:   {auc_before:.4f}\")\n",
        "print(f\"AUC después: {auc_after:.4f}\")\n"
      ],
      "id": "1XbZFhoP-bpK"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "wVfTPMmL-bpK"
      },
      "source": [
        "#### Curvas ROC antes y después de calibrar\n",
        "\n",
        "Como DermaMNIST tiene 7 clases, se calcula una **ROC macro One-vs-Rest**.\n",
        "\n",
        "Las dos curvas parten del mismo origen porque una curva ROC siempre comienza en `(0,0)`. Temperature Scaling normalmente no cambia mucho su forma, ya que principalmente modifica la confianza de las probabilidades.\n"
      ],
      "id": "wVfTPMmL-bpK"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 487
        },
        "id": "ClO6iuT5-bpK",
        "outputId": "f42e8d3d-92b2-4452-89cd-784007590010"
      },
      "execution_count": 30,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "display_data",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "<Figure size 700x500 with 1 Axes>"
            ],
            "image/png": "\n"
          },
          "metadata": {}
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "from sklearn.preprocessing import label_binarize\n",
        "from sklearn.metrics import roc_curve, auc\n",
        "\n",
        "def macro_roc_curve(y_true, probs, n_classes):\n",
        "    y_bin = label_binarize(\n",
        "        y_true,\n",
        "        classes=np.arange(n_classes)\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    common_fpr = np.linspace(0, 1, 200)\n",
        "    tprs = []\n",
        "\n",
        "    for class_id in range(n_classes):\n",
        "        fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(\n",
        "            y_bin[:, class_id],\n",
        "            probs[:, class_id]\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "        interp_tpr = np.interp(\n",
        "            common_fpr,\n",
        "            fpr,\n",
        "            tpr\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "        interp_tpr[0] = 0.0\n",
        "        tprs.append(interp_tpr)\n",
        "\n",
        "    mean_tpr = np.mean(tprs, axis=0)\n",
        "    mean_tpr[-1] = 1.0\n",
        "\n",
        "    macro_auc = auc(\n",
        "        common_fpr,\n",
        "        mean_tpr\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    return common_fpr, mean_tpr, macro_auc\n",
        "\n",
        "fpr_before, tpr_before, roc_auc_before = macro_roc_curve(\n",
        "    y_test,\n",
        "    probs_before,\n",
        "    num_classes\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "fpr_after, tpr_after, roc_auc_after = macro_roc_curve(\n",
        "    y_test,\n",
        "    probs_after,\n",
        "    num_classes\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(7, 5))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    fpr_before,\n",
        "    tpr_before,\n",
        "    linewidth=2,\n",
        "    label=f\"Antes de calibrar (AUC={roc_auc_before:.3f})\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    fpr_after,\n",
        "    tpr_after,\n",
        "    linewidth=2,\n",
        "    label=f\"Después de calibrar (AUC={roc_auc_after:.3f})\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.plot(\n",
        "    [0, 1],\n",
        "    [0, 1],\n",
        "    \"--\",\n",
        "    linewidth=1,\n",
        "    label=\"Azar\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.title(\"Ejercicio 5 - Curvas ROC macro\")\n",
        "plt.xlabel(\"False Positive Rate\")\n",
        "plt.ylabel(\"True Positive Rate\")\n",
        "plt.legend()\n",
        "plt.grid(alpha=0.2)\n",
        "plt.show()\n"
      ],
      "id": "ClO6iuT5-bpK"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "g2IrlC0N-bpK"
      },
      "source": [
        "**Comentario — Ejercicio 5:** si las curvas ROC quedan muy próximas no significa que la calibración haya fallado. Temperature Scaling modifica principalmente la confianza de las probabilidades y no necesariamente cambia el orden de las predicciones. Por eso también se compara el NLL.\n"
      ],
      "id": "g2IrlC0N-bpK"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "markdown",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "xg_MJq4s-bpK"
      },
      "source": [
        "## 8. Interpretabilidad básica: Grad-CAM\n",
        "\n",
        "En salud, entender por qué el modelo decide puede ser importante.\n",
        "\n",
        "**Grad-CAM** produce un mapa de calor sobre la imagen, indicando las regiones que más influyeron en la predicción.\n"
      ],
      "id": "xg_MJq4s-bpK"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "id": "hEjlFXh7-bpL"
      },
      "execution_count": 31,
      "outputs": [],
      "source": [
        "def grad_cam(model, image_tensor, target_class=None):\n",
        "    model.eval()\n",
        "    image_tensor = image_tensor.to(device)\n",
        "\n",
        "    activations = {}\n",
        "    gradients = {}\n",
        "\n",
        "    def forward_hook(module, inp, out):\n",
        "        activations[\"value\"] = out\n",
        "\n",
        "    def backward_hook(module, grad_in, grad_out):\n",
        "        gradients[\"value\"] = grad_out[0]\n",
        "\n",
        "    handle_fwd = model.layer4.register_forward_hook(\n",
        "        forward_hook\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    handle_bwd = model.layer4.register_full_backward_hook(\n",
        "        backward_hook\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    logits = model(\n",
        "        image_tensor.unsqueeze(0)\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    if target_class is None:\n",
        "        target_class = int(\n",
        "            torch.argmax(\n",
        "                logits,\n",
        "                dim=1\n",
        "            ).item()\n",
        "        )\n",
        "\n",
        "    score = logits[0, target_class]\n",
        "\n",
        "    model.zero_grad()\n",
        "    score.backward()\n",
        "\n",
        "    act = activations[\"value\"][0]\n",
        "    grad = gradients[\"value\"][0]\n",
        "\n",
        "    weights = torch.mean(\n",
        "        grad,\n",
        "        dim=(1, 2)\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    cam = torch.sum(\n",
        "        weights[:, None, None] * act,\n",
        "        dim=0\n",
        "    )\n",
        "\n",
        "    cam = torch.relu(cam)\n",
        "    cam = cam - cam.min()\n",
        "    cam = cam / (cam.max() + 1e-8)\n",
        "\n",
        "    handle_fwd.remove()\n",
        "    handle_bwd.remove()\n",
        "\n",
        "    return cam.detach().cpu().numpy(), target_class\n"
      ],
      "id": "hEjlFXh7-bpL"
    },
    {
      "cell_type": "code",
      "metadata": {
        "colab": {
          "base_uri": "https://localhost:8080/",
          "height": 410
        },
        "id": "5vMs85cK-bpL",
        "outputId": "267f28f8-e1f6-4e31-95c3-1a3259fbdc1f"
      },
      "execution_count": 32,
      "outputs": [
        {
          "output_type": "stream",
          "name": "stderr",
          "text": [
            "<sys>:0: UserWarning: Full backward hook is firing when gradients are computed with respect to module outputs since no inputs require gradients. See https://docs.pytorch.org/docs/main/generated/torch.nn.Module.html#torch.nn.Module.register_full_backward_hook for more details.\n"
          ]
        },
        {
          "output_type": "display_data",
          "data": {
            "text/plain": [
              "<Figure size 1000x400 with 3 Axes>"
            ],
            "image/png": "\n"
          },
          "metadata": {}
        }
      ],
      "source": [
        "idx = 0\n",
        "x, y = test_dataset_tl[idx]\n",
        "\n",
        "cam, pred_class = grad_cam(\n",
        "    resnet,\n",
        "    x\n",
        ")\n",
        "\n",
        "mean = torch.tensor(\n",
        "    imagenet_mean\n",
        ").view(3, 1, 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "std = torch.tensor(\n",
        "    imagenet_std\n",
        ").view(3, 1, 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "x_vis = (\n",
        "    x.cpu() * std + mean\n",
        ").clamp(0, 1)\n",
        "\n",
        "img = x_vis.permute(\n",
        "    1, 2, 0\n",
        ").numpy()\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 4))\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.subplot(1, 3, 1)\n",
        "plt.imshow(img)\n",
        "plt.title(\n",
        "    f\"Imagen (label={int(np.asarray(y).item())})\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "plt.axis(\"off\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.subplot(1, 3, 2)\n",
        "plt.imshow(cam)\n",
        "plt.title(\n",
        "    f\"Grad-CAM (pred={pred_class})\"\n",
        ")\n",
        "plt.axis(\"off\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.subplot(1, 3, 3)\n",
        "plt.imshow(img)\n",
        "plt.imshow(\n",
        "    cam,\n",
        "    alpha=0.5\n",
        ")\n",
        "plt.title(\"Superposición\")\n",
        "plt.axis(\"off\")\n",
        "\n",
        "plt.tight_layout()\n",
        "plt.show()\n"
      ],

      "source": [
        "## 9. Buenas prácticas (especialmente en salud)\n",
        "\n",
        "1) **Separación estricta** de train/val/test.\n",
        "\n",
        "2) Reportar métricas más allá de accuracy.\n",
        "\n",
        "3) Cuidado con sesgos y desbalance.\n",
        "\n",
        "4) Usar validación para escoger configuraciones.\n",
        "\n",
        "5) Grad-CAM es útil como ayuda visual.\n",
        "\n",
        "6) Fijar seeds y guardar modelos.\n"
      ],
      "id": "gBTMXgN6-bpL"
